correctness.rationale: Reconstructed strong-Bruhat rank-matrix comparability and Kazhdan–Lusztig right-descent R-polynomial recurrence, saturated at two at q=2. Deodhar positivity and Gorsky–Kim–Sherman-Bennett Lemma 3.1 identify R_{v,w}(2)=1 with toric intervals. An independent C++ implementation enumerated all 5,040 permutations, 3,550,919 comparable endpoint pairs, and computed the full exact toric vector (5040,33984,111910,229848,312552,276604,146138,37852,3448,64) and Boolean smooth vector (5040,33984,111910,223704,286108,231484,111064,27484,2736,64); their complement totals 123,862. The separate supplied forbidden two-crown recurrence was inspected; not merely trusting its VERIFY_OK. All dimensions d>9 had zero toric intervals. Exhaustive finite S7 computation is appropriate for the precisely finite claim, not a general-n proof.
